items.title: Establish the club's online presence
items.text: Website work begins under the Webmaster role, giving students a clearer way to discover meetings, activities and opportunities.

items.title: Make club activity visible
items.text: Capture meeting photos, student participation and hands-on activities so the club builds a record of what members actually do.

items.title: Move beyond a one-page website
items.text: Organize the club website into clear pages for meetings, learning resources, projects, impact and membership.

items.title: Create progression for members
items.text: Help beginners move from basic lessons to build challenges, project teams, teaching and leadership instead of attending disconnected meetings.

items.title: Track outcomes without guessing
items.text: Record verified projects completed, workshops delivered, volunteer activity and students reached so the Impact page reflects real work.

items.title: Leave future officers a working system
items.text: Organize resources, project documentation and website structure so the next leadership team can continue improving the club rather than rebuilding from scratch.
